$comment: What coworkee update knows about each Coworkee version: breaking changes of website/docs/reference/changelog.md, automatic renames and package bumps, manual steps with the code they concern. A version's rules apply when an app moves past it.

breaking: Coworkee.Testing: PostgresFixture is now DatabaseFixture (Postgres, SQL Server or SQLite through COWORKEE_TEST_DATABASE) and PostgresWebApplicationFactory is now DatabaseWebApplicationFactory.

manual.text: DatabaseFixture.ConnectionString is set in InitializeAsync; fixtures that passed the connection string themselves use fixture.Settings(connectionStringName) now.

breaking: Aspire 13.6.1: the app host SDK and Aspire.Hosting.Testing move to 13.6.1.
The web host needs app.UseWebAssemblyDebugging() in Development, otherwise Visual Studio cannot attach to the browser (wss://.../_framework/debug/ws-proxy).

manual.text: Add `if (app.Environment.IsDevelopment()) { app.UseWebAssemblyDebugging(); }` before the app is mapped in the web host.

breaking: Mail: IMailTransport (SMTP, SendGrid, Mailgun, Mailchimp Transactional) replaces ISmtpTransport.
GET /api/v1/services returns { services, unavailableSources } instead of a list.
Theming: the theme property LogoSvg is now Logo (SVG markup or an image data URL); the column is renamed, add a migration.
Removed with MudBlazor.Extensions 9.11.3: ChipListEditor, CronEditor, CronSchedule and SettingsFormRules.WrapInColumns; lists of strings render as MudExTagField<string>, [Cron] renders MudExCronEdit.
.NET packages 10.0.13 (the advisories of 2026-10-13 fail builds with NU1903 on 10.0.12).

manual.text: Implement IMailTransport instead of ISmtpTransport (SendAsync gets the whole message and the transport settings).
GET /api/v1/services answers { services, unavailableSources }; read .services.
ChipListEditor, CronEditor and CronSchedule are gone: use MudExTagField<string> (or RenderAsChips) and MudExCronEdit ([Cron]).

breaking: IMailSender requires the six-parameter QueueAsync(to, template, model, culture, campaignId, cancellationToken).
IMailTemplateRenderer gained RenderContentAsync(content, layout, model, cancellationToken).
Positional records gained parameters: MailTemplateSummaryDto (IsCustom, Description), MailTemplateDto (IsCustom), OutgoingMailDto (CampaignId); regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.
Mail campaigns, recipient lists and own templates change the model: add a migration.

manual.text: Own IMailSender implementations implement the six-parameter QueueAsync (with campaignId).
Own IMailTemplateRenderer implementations add RenderContentAsync.
Pass the new positional parameters (IsCustom, Description, CampaignId).

breaking: ClientEntityIndicator removed: mirrored tables show the ClientEntitySwitch in their tool bar.
ODataPicker.Margin and OptionalODataPicker.Margin are Margin? now.
CliOption gained DependsOn and OptionDependency gained Or (binary incompatible for tools compiled against an older Coworkee.Cli.Spec).
LoadingScreenDto gained the positional parameter SignedIn; regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.
Enums in every MudExObjectEdit render with the EnumEditor.
Every app shows the loading screen: one line as the first line of <body> in App.razor of the web host.
Public files: StoredFile.IsPublic; apps with the Files module add a migration.

manual.text: Delete <ClientEntityIndicator> and an own Compare button: the ClientEntitySwitch is in the tool bar.
ODataPicker.Margin is Margin? now: add ?? Margin.Dense where it is read as Margin.
Pass SignedIn to LoadingScreenDto.

breaking: ICoworkeeApi gained AddMailTemplateLanguageAsync, GetPushSettingsAsync, SavePushSubscriptionAsync and DeletePushSubscriptionAsync; own implementations add them.
Notification derives from AggregateRoot (it raises NotificationCreated for Web Push); no schema change from that.
IODataClient.ExportAsync and ImportAsync are removed: exports and the import wizard go through IDataTransferApi.
ODataImportRegistration has Create, Update and Delete instead of Send; AddODataImport takes (Guid? id, row) => command and an optional delete command.

CoworkeeODataModule depends on CoworkeeBackgroundJobsModule (imports and large exports run as jobs); test hosts with OData set Coworkee:Jobs:ConnectionStringName and create their tables before UseCoworkee().
New tables cw.PushSubscriptions (Notifications), cw.DataTransferJobs and cw.ImportProfiles (OData): add a migration. Workflows and Webhooks bring their own tables when an app adds them.
Phone layout: the viewport tag of App.razor needs viewport-fit=cover.
New endpoints for push, mail template languages, import/export, history, workflows and webhooks: regenerate OpenAPI snapshots and SDKs.

Library pages live under /cw/admin/... instead of /admin/... (CoworkeeClientOptions.PagePrefix, "" keeps the old addresses); one catch-all page (/{*Path}) renders them, so an app page with its own catch-all route is ambiguous. Old addresses redirect.
ICoworkeeApi gained GetSystemStatusAsync; own implementations add it.
IWorkflowApi gained GetStatesAsync (POST /api/v1/workflows/{entityType}/states); own implementations add it.
Webhooks: two new columns on cw.WebhookSubscriptions (secret rotation); apps with webhooks add a migration.
KeycloakRealm moved from Aspire.Hosting to Coworkee.Contracts.Identity.

Deployments take the app host's tools along: Migrations/Program.cs seeds InitialAdmin and reconciles the Keycloak realm, ServiceDefaults exports to Grafana per signal (GRAFANA_OTLP_PROTOCOL), AppHost.cs uses app.Deploys(...) and aspireUi.WithCoworkee(app).
SyncDevelopmentUsersAsync() (Development only) keeps the seed users of an existing database in step; the migrations host calls it after SeedCoworkeeIdentityAsync().

manual.text: Own ICoworkeeApi implementations add AddMailTemplateLanguageAsync, GetPushSettingsAsync, SavePushSubscriptionAsync and DeletePushSubscriptionAsync.
IODataClient.ExportAsync/ImportAsync are gone: use IDataTransferApi; own IODataClient fakes drop the two methods.
ODataImportRegistration.Send is now Create/Update/Delete; for updates and undo pass (Guid? id, row) => command and id => delete command to AddODataImport.
Test hosts with OData need Coworkee:Jobs:ConnectionStringName (RunServer=false) and their tables created before UseCoworkee().

Links to library admin pages move to /cw/admin/... (old addresses redirect); an own catch-all page (@page "/{*...}") clashes with the library one: give it a prefix or set CoworkeeClientOptions.PagePrefix.
Own ICoworkeeApi implementations add GetSystemStatusAsync.
Own IWorkflowApi implementations add GetStatesAsync.
KeycloakRealm is in Coworkee.Contracts.Identity now: add using Coworkee.Contracts.Identity;.

Seed the first administrator of a deployment: var admin = InitialAdmin.From(builder.Configuration); AddCoworkeeIdentitySeed(IsDevelopment ? DemoSeed.Configure : o => DemoSeed.ConfigureDeployment(o, admin!)); seed only in Development or with an admin, then call host.Services.SyncDevelopmentUsersAsync() and scope.ServiceProvider.ReconcileKeycloakRealmAsync() (see the template Migrations/Program.cs).

Grafana exporter per signal: with GRAFANA_OTLP_PROTOCOL=http/protobuf use {endpoint}/v1/{logs|metrics|traces} over HttpProtobuf, exporters grafana-logs/-metrics/-traces (see the template ServiceDefaults/Extensions.cs).

App host: add Ollama when app.Deploys(CoworkeeTools.Ollama) and AspireUI when app.Deploys(CoworkeeTools.AspireUI) with builder.AddAspireUI().WithCoworkee(app).WithRetrieveApi() (seed from the directory only in run mode) instead of IsRunMode checks.

breaking: AddCommandPaletteEntitySet and CommandPaletteEntitySet<T> are removed: the command palette finds records through the global search of the server; register the set there with services.AddGlobalSearch<T>(s => s.Fields(...).Page(...)).

manual.text: Move the palette search of the set to the server module that registers its OData set: services.AddGlobalSearch<TEntity>(s => s.Fields(e => e.Name).Subtitle(...).Page("/list-page")), then delete the client registration.
